name: Overseer
overview: Scripture presents the overseer as a divinely appointed leader responsible for the spiritual care and oversight of God's people, as emphasized in Acts 20:28 where overseers are called to feed the church purchased by Christ's blood. Proverbs 27:23 underscores the importance of diligence in knowing the condition of the flock, reflecting the heart required for this role. The qualifications for overseers include blameless character and faithful family management, as outlined in Titus 1:6, while Philippians 1:1 connects overseers (bishops) with deacons as servants of Christ. The warnings in Matthew 24:48-49 highlight the dangers of neglect and unfaithfulness in stewardship, urging overseers to remain vigilant and responsible.
